E1: FIX — ontology glosses for culturally_sensitive and exaggerated_or_stereotypical restate the predicate names; replace them with definitions that say what makes them true.
E2: FIX — closure: change cepa to unclear, because the clause obliges willingness and does not state a default permission for speaking; the reason "silence permits" is circular.
E3: PASS
E4: FIX — asserts: change the first assert from permit speak_in_accent(A) to oblige be_willing_to_speak_in_accent(A), and delete the ontology entries that assert every accent is culturally sensitive and exaggerated.
E5: FIX — ontology: remove the two entries with body speak_in_accent(A), since an act is not a situation fact and the body cannot discriminate; re-encode as conditions on the act.
E6: FIX — claims: C1 and C2 are not encoded as norms; C1 is a permit instead of an oblige on willingness, and C2 has no assert, only a false ontology fact.
E7: PASS
E8: FIX — forbid: the body exaggerated_or_stereotypical(A) is derived from an ontology entry true for every accent, so the prohibition is widened to all accents; make the body a condition on the act, not a fact derived from the act.
E9: PASS
E10: PASS
E11: FIX — ontology: culturally_sensitive(A) and exaggerated_or_stereotypical(A) share the identical body speak_in_accent(A), making them coextensive and causing both permit and forbid on every accent; give them different bodies or remove them.
